title: Impact of Heart Rate Variability Modulation on Stress Management Among Physicians
official: Impact of Heart Rate Variability Modulation on Stress and Recovery Among Physicians
summary: The purpose of this research is to examine a wearable device called Apollo that emits gentle vibrations found to benefit mood, energy, and focus. We want to understand how it affects burnout in physicians.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* UPMC attending physicians and residents. The participants must have either IOS or Android phones.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwillingness or inability to participate in the study
* Currently own an Apollo device
